Calculates the number of wins/losses needed in different modes of PVP before achieving your target Series Level
- Receive post-match notifications about progress towards next Series Level
- Track and display Series Level above 30
- Calculate Frontline losing streak bonus rewards

Use /pmalm to get started

raw_manifest_json.TestingChangelog:
Features:
- Tracks Series Level above 30, even if you claim the "Extra Level" rewards
- Option to modify PVP Profile and Series Malmstone GUI to show Series Levels above 30
- Organize Configuration into tabs
- Add a warning message about not gaining Series EXP for the people who somehow reach 100 unclaimed extra level rewards (infinite levels above Level 30)
